description: One video game in full from IGDB, by numeric id or slug: summary and storyline, per-platform release dates and regions, genres, themes, game modes, player perspectives, franchise, developer and publisher, critic and user ratings, DLC, expansions, similar games and cover art. Use after igdb_search_games. Example: igdb_game({ slug: "the-legend-of-zelda-breath-of-the-wild" }).

_apiKey.description: Twitch app credentials as "CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET" (IGDB is gated by Twitch OAuth). Optional — omit to use the shared Pipeworx credential. Get your own at https://dev.twitch.tv/console.
